turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Why did my son find out about a zero on his phone, in class?
I'll stand. Who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
What phone call? Nobody called me before that zero went in. Who decided it?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. I'm not here to be flattered into a zero. What do you have besides a score?
